purpose: Learn a continuous race-context x volatility loss surface and choose how much probability dispersion to apply without binary danger gates or discrete per-action models.

core.training_surface: context features + family/sigma/lambda -> observed prior-race TRIFECTA NLL delta versus BASE_PL
core.policy: predict dense candidate surface, shrink chosen sigma toward a prior-only static optimum, and fall back to BASE_PL when predicted gain is insufficient
core.nested_validation: policy shrinkage and fallback threshold selected only on the latest available prior validation period
core.oracle: dense-grid outcome oracle is diagnostic only
